steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In April 2023, Equity Mates listed Newcrest Mining among Australia’s biggest gold producers when outlining ways to invest in gold miners, highlighting its scale in gold production.

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In July 2022, Equity Mates covered a Macquarie list of recession-proof stocks that chose Newcrest Mining for gold exposure, presenting it as a defensive pick during downturns.

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?
Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In December 2022, Equity Mates said gold equities had rallied and Newcrest Mining was doing quite well, prompting a discussion about taking profits after strong moves, noting Evolution was up almost 50% from its lows.

episode.title: Martin Crabb comes back to review his predictions from 2022!
